Resolves #21679

Moves the bottom header seam in timeline-bearing grids off `.neo-grid-header-toolbar` onto the header items themselves (`box-shadow: inset 0 -1px var(--neo-timeline-border-color)` on `.neo-timeline-header` and `border-bottom-color: var(--grid-container-border-color)` on sibling plain/tree `.neo-grid-header-button` items, both at rest and on `:hover`), so `.neo-timeline-now` in the minor row covers the timeline's bottom edge and meets the first row's segment with `0px` gap while every column's bottom edge stays aligned on the same pixel row without shifting any toolbar or body.

Evidence: L3 (rendered-rect E2E across Gantt, Scheduler, and plain locked-column grids + 1440 × 900 and 2× DPR seam frames in `neo-dark` and `neo-light`) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-5).

Related: #21671, #21672, #20890, #20874

## AC Evidence

| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/gantt/NowLine.spec.mjs` asserts `Math.abs(segments[0].top - headerNow.bottom) <= 0.5` (`0px` measured at head vs `2px` on `origin/dev`) across `examples/gantt/basic` and `examples/scheduler/basic` in `neo-theme-neo-light` and `neo-theme-neo-dark` |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/gantt/NowLine.spec.mjs` asserts `.neo-timeline-header`'s `inset 0 -1px` bottom edge and plain/tree `.neo-grid-header-button` `1px solid` bottom borders remain visible (rest and `:hover`) at one shared `y` (`121px` in Gantt, `133px` in Scheduler), with `toolbarBottoms` and `bodyTops` unmoved |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/gantt/NowLine.spec.mjs` › "grid without a timeline column keeps its toolbar bottom border and transparent button bottom border" verifies `examples/grid/lockedColumns` |
| AC-4 | Outside-CI red-first receipt below (`4 failed` on `origin/dev` `7cd0d6618e` with `seamGap = 2px` → `6/6` passed at head) |
| AC-5 | Seam (2× DPR) and whole `1440 × 900` before/after frames embedded under `## Test Evidence` |

## Deltas from ticket

- Post-filing commit `06768e6409` (`#21702` / `#21714`) added `&:hover { ... border-bottom-color: var(--neo-timeline-border-color); box-shadow: none; }` on `.neo-timeline-header.neo-grid-header-button`, and `scheduler/Container.css:6` sets `--grid-header-button-border-hover-color: transparent` on plain header buttons (`Button.css:50`). Both `:hover` rules carry the bottom-edge styles (`inset 0 -1px` on `.neo-timeline-header:hover` and `border-bottom-color: var(--grid-container-border-color)` on `.neo-grid-header-button:not(.neo-timeline-header):hover`), pinned by hover assertions in `NowLine.spec.mjs`.

## Test Evidence

- **Red-first on `origin/dev` (`7cd0d6618e`):** `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs test/playwright/e2e/gantt/NowLine.spec.mjs` failed all 4 timeline/theme arms at `expect(Math.abs(result.seamGap)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.5)` (`Received: 2`, `headerNowBottom: 119` vs `firstSegTop: 121` in Gantt; `131` vs `133` in Scheduler) while passing the `examples/grid/lockedColumns` control arm.
- **Green at head:** `6/6` passed (`5.9s`), with `seamGap: 0`, `toolbarBottoms: [121, 121]` / `bodyTops: [121, 121]` in Gantt and `[133, 133]` in Scheduler.

Frame critique: In `examples/scheduler/basic` (`60px` 2-hour minor ticks at `pxPerMinute: 0.5`) with `now` at `13:00` (`30px` into the `12:00` tick), `.neo-timeline-now` crosses the right edge of the `12:00` minor-tick label — pre-existing on `origin/dev` (`7cd0d6618e`), out of scope, noted in defect-note `06c8c743`. In `neo-theme-neo-dark`, the locked column header's bottom border uses `--grid-container-border-color` (`var(--purple-800)`), matching `dev`'s toolbar/row borders and `#21679` Step 4, while the timeline header's inset edge uses `--neo-timeline-border-color` (`#262f3d`).
